title: Minimal DrawingML Graphics Device for openxlsx2
text: small graphics device writes R plots directly OOXML DrawingML shapes, use openxlsx2::wb_add_drawing(). Cairo, FreeType, fontconfig, xml2 dependency.

title: Minimal DrawingML Graphics Device for openxlsx2

title: Minimal DrawingML Graphics Device for openxlsx2
text: easel_dev() opens device returns file path. Draw R plotting system, call dev.(), hand file openxlsx2::wb_add_drawing().
code: library(easeling) library(openxlsx2)  f <- easel_dev(width = 6, height = 4) plot(1:10, (1:10)^2, type = "b") dev.off()  wb <- wb_workbook()$add_worksheet()$add_drawing(xml = f, dims = "A1")

title: Minimal DrawingML Graphics Device for openxlsx2

title: Minimal DrawingML Graphics Device for openxlsx2
code: library(ggplot2)  f <- easel_dev(width = 6, height = 4) print(   ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg, color = factor(cyl))) +     geom_point() +     theme_minimal() ) dev.off()  wb$add_worksheet()$add_drawing(xml = f, dims = "A1")  if (interactive()) wb$open()

title: Minimal DrawingML Graphics Device for openxlsx2
text: Text uses estimated font metrics, real font data — layout depends precise text measurement (legend spacing, centered labels) may slightly , especially unusual fonts. Fonts referenced name , embedded. viewer needs font installed, falls back silently. Gradient fills (grid::linearGradient()/radialGradient()) supported; tiling patterns clip paths/masks .

title: Open a DrawingML graphics device for openxlsx2 — easel_dev
text: Draws directly standalone DrawingML XML file containing `xdr:sp` shapes, suitable `openxlsx2::wb_add_drawing(xml = file)`. dependency Cairo, FreeType, fontconfig, xml2.

title: Open a DrawingML graphics device for openxlsx2 — easel_dev
code: easel_dev(   file = tempfile(fileext = ".xml"),   width = 6,   height = 6,   pointsize = 12,   fontname = "Calibri",   underline = FALSE,   strikeout = FALSE,   dims = NULL,   wb = NULL,   sheet = 1,   text_voff = 0.35 )

title: Open a DrawingML graphics device for openxlsx2 — easel_dev
text: file Path output XML file. Defaults temp file. width, height Device size inches. pointsize Default font pointsize. fontname Default font typeface (matches `openxlsx2::wb_add_font()`'s `name` argument), e.g. `"Calibri"`, `"Arial"`. Used whenever R request specific family — .e. whenever plot's `family`/`fontfamily` unset one R's generic aliases (`"sans"`, `"serif"`, `"mono"`, `"symbol"`, `""`). plot sets actual font name (e.g. `par(family = "Georgia")` `theme_minimal(base_family = "Georgia")`), takes priority default. underline, strikeout Apply underline/strikeout text device. Unlike `fontname`, per-call R equivalent (base graphics underline/strikeout concept), device-wide setting. dims Optionally, cell range `"A1:G15"`. given, `width` `height` ignored computed region via [easel_size()], plot fills region exactly later anchored `dims`. wb, sheet Passed [easel_size()] `dims` given: `openxlsx2` workbook (sheet) read actual column widths row heights . text_voff Vertical text calibration em: text boxes centre-anchored, baseline placed `text_voff` em box centre. default `0.35` calibrated Excel's line layout Calibri; LibreOffice's optimum around 0.24, text sits ~0.1 em low. Increase shift rendered text , decrease shift , spreadsheet application's line layout places visibly ; see `system.file("examples", "calibrate_text.R", package = "easeling")`.

title: Compute the device size for a spreadsheet cell region — easel_size
text: Translates cell range like `"A1:G15"` device size inches, plot drawn size fills region exactly anchored `dims` — dims-first workflow: pick region, size device , plot. device opened final size, R lays text, margins, legends size; nothing needs rescaled afterwards (DrawingML rescale text groups).

title: Compute the device size for a spreadsheet cell region — easel_size
Compute the device size for a spreadsheet cell region — easel_size
text: dims cell range `"A1:G15"` (corners inclusive). wb Optionally, `openxlsx2` workbook (`wbWorkbook`) read actual column widths row heights . sheet Sheet index `wb`. Default `1`.

title: Compute the device size for a spreadsheet cell region — easel_size
Compute the device size for a spreadsheet cell region — easel_size
text: Column widths row heights taken `wb` given, including custom widths/heights sheet defaults stored `sheetFormatPr`. Without `wb`, Excel's defaults assumed (Calibri 11: 8.43 character column width = 64px, 15pt row height = 20px). character--pixel conversion uses Excel's formula maximum digit width 7px; workbooks different base font ratio digit widths.
